tours.name: Add an Other Input Type
tours.description: Learn how to add an input type, such as Bonus or Overtime adjustment, that payroll officers can enter on a single payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to add an input type, such as Bonus or Overtime adjustment, that payroll officers can enter on a single payslip.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Input types are configured in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Input types are configured in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Payroll app, such as salary structures, rules and input types.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Payroll app, such as salary structures, rules and input types.

steps.title: Other Input Types
steps.description: Other input types are the kinds of one-off amount that can be added to a payslip. Each type is linked to a salary rule that includes the amount in the pay.

description_i18n.en_US: Other input types are the kinds of one-off amount that can be added to a payslip. Each type is linked to a salary rule that includes the amount in the pay.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to create a record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a record.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank form.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank form.

steps.title: Name
steps.content: Type the name, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name, then press Tab.

steps.description: Use the label payroll officers will recognise, for example Performance bonus. It is shown in the Other Inputs table of the payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: Use the label payroll officers will recognise, for example Performance bonus. It is shown in the Other Inputs table of the payslip.

steps.title: Code
steps.content: Type the code, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the code, then press Tab.

steps.description: The code identifies the input in salary rule formulas. Keep it short, in capital letters, for example BONUS.

description_i18n.en_US: The code identifies the input in salary rule formulas. Keep it short, in capital letters, for example BONUS.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the record.

steps.description: Saving creates the input type. It can then be added to payslips of the structures it is linked to.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving creates the input type. It can then be added to payslips of the structures it is linked to.

steps.title: Saved
steps.content: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

steps.description: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.

description_i18n.en_US: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.
